phase: OECD Counterpart Discovery — Semantic + Lineage Review

mappings_not_supported.BNR: S121 is absent from retained Romania reporting-sector and counterpart-sector observations.
mappings_not_supported.F: RMD F requires financial corporations excluding the central bank (S12 - S121), but S121 is absent, so the exact identity cannot be constructed.

SECTOR_MAPPING.rule_applied: Every required RMD sector H,C,F,G,BNR,X must have an explicit source-code construction. Missing S121 is an unconditional semantic-review FAIL and cannot be repaired by residual allocation, treating BNR as zero, or collapsing BNR into F.

COUNTERPART_ORIENTATION.evidence: Separate SECTOR and COUNTERPART_SECTOR dimensions plus ACCOUNTING_ENTRY A/L explicitly identify reporter/counterpart and asset/liability orientation.

INSTRUMENT_MAPPING.evidence: Retained Romania stocks and flows expose exact total instrument codes F2 through F8 and component detail.

STOCK_FLOW_SEMANTICS.evidence: Separate counterpart dataflows publish stocks with TRANSACTION=LE (closing balance sheet/positions/stocks) and flows with TRANSACTION=F (transactions in financial assets and liabilities).

ASSET_LIABILITY_SEMANTICS.evidence: ACCOUNTING_ENTRY explicitly contains A assets/net acquisition and L liabilities/net incurrence; N net is also available.

UNIT_SCALING.evidence: UNIT_MEASURE=XDC national currency, UNIT_MULT=6 millions and CURRENCY=RON Romanian leu are explicit in retained Romania data.

CONSOLIDATION_AND_VALUATION.evidence: CONSOLIDATION=N non-consolidated, VALUATION=S standard valuation based on SNA/ESA and PRICE_BASE=V current prices are explicit.

LINEAGE.evidence: OECD documents Quarterly Sector Accounts (Financial part) as an OECD-ECB collection; OECD dissemination is therefore not assumed statistically independent from the European financial-accounts source chain.

next_action: Keep sectoral_financial_positions at PARTIAL_SERIES_AVAILABLE. Reopen external counterpart recovery only for a new official source or changed public dataset version that provides both the frozen RMD sector split including S121 and the full F2-F8 stock/transaction instrument boundary without prohibited substitutions.
